title: highlight not exported in dom.js
body:
`highlight` function is not exported in dom.js. The doc [here](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/gettingstarted.html#add-a-searchbox) says to import from `react-instantsearch/dom`. 

It gives an error when I am importing as given in doc.

comments.body: Thanks this is definitely a bug. I am going to put it back for now and we will have to think twice about this helper because we need to make it compatible for react native too and for anyone not using our widgets too
